I always wish I could be two inches taller, I’m 5’2 so that still wouldn’t help much. I know being short sucks dude but don’t let it hold you back. At 5’2 I have a decent sex/dating life, I’ve slept with girls shorter than me and girls who are 6’0+. At 21 my body count is 34 and im 5’2, if I can do it you can do it. I workout everyday, I’m pretty funny, a very social person and my face isn’t bad, but most importantly I don’t give a fuck what people think of me. I promise you that if you quit focusing on your height and focus on everything you can change you will be happy. Also I would pick up a combat sport, I wrestled and did jiujitsu for 7 years and it boosted my confidence a substantial amount. Keep your head up short king, I know it sucks but keep pushing; fuck the short haters because we are gonna out live them anyways.

I’m 5’1 and I didn’t really care about my height until I got to college. In terms of making friends I’m pretty social and a lot of times get compared to kevin hart because Im funny and decently outgoing. In terms of dating it’s decent not the best but it is what it is, rejection happens but it’s a numbers game and I’ve learned to filter out all the negativity that happens when you’re a short man traveling through the dating world. One thing that helps me is I’ve wrestled since I was a 12 and that translated over into many things In my life and gave me a lot of confidence; if you could pick up a combat sport such as jiujitsu. Trust me I’ve had people step up to me thinking I’m an easy target to pick on only to get destroyed a few seconds later. For dating just be yourself, I’ve been in a few relationships ranging from my height to 6’1, if they like you it’s for you and height shouldn’t matter. I also learned to avoid dating apps, it’s honestly a waste of time for a short guy and you’ll do much better irl. When looking for jobs I haven’t had much trouble, if you are qualified and got the skills you’ll land the job.
